messages:
Asha (Sales): Quick heads up — we're kicking off the internal rollout for the new ratecard v2026.1 this morning. Need to align on POC handling, legacy commit mapping, and the temporary APAC surcharge rule before we send external comms.
Ben (Deal Desk): Thanks — can you summarize the open questions so we can action?
Asha (Sales): Sure — short list: 1) How do we map old POC SKUs to the new tiering automatically? 2) Grandfathering window for commits (start/end dates) 3) When do we apply the 3% APAC infra surcharge vs waiving for enterprise POCs? 4) Deal desk fastpass criteria for one-off discounts.
Clara (RevOps): For (1) we have a migration script but it needs a manual flag for non-standard SKUs. If we want auto-map, we'll need a short maintenance window to run backfills.
Darin (AE): Asha — a couple of active POCs are on weird custom SKUs from earlier pilots; manual flag yes, but who's ownership for approvals? Sales or Deal Desk?
Ben (Deal Desk): Deal Desk owns approvals. Suggest policy: auto-map standard SKUs, surface exceptions to a queue for Ben/Darin to review. We can triage within 24 hours.
Asha (Sales): OK that works. For (2) — thinking of a 60-day grandfather window from the publish date for existing commits. Thoughts?
Clara (RevOps): 60 days is reasonable, but we need clear rules for partial-month billing and backfill credit. I'll draft the billing note.
Jo (Legal): On special terms, we should mark any legacy SLAs that reference deprecated SKUs and require amendment. I'll draft a short amendment template for legal sign-off.
Ben (Deal Desk): On APAC surcharge: propose default apply 3% to marketplace/reseller deals, but waive for enterprise POCs that sign an NDA and commit to a minimum usage threshold. That prevents surprise fees during short trials.
Asha (Sales): Good call. Can we make that threshold 50k tokens per month for the POC? Reasonable?
Clara (RevOps): 50k/month is OK as a starting threshold — we can create an exceptions tag. Also will add a note to the billing system to show the surcharge line item for transparency.
Ratecard Bot: ratecard.v2026.1 published to internal docs -> https://redwood.internal/docs/ratecard/v2026.1 (policy, mapping table, migration checklist) :loudspeaker:
Darin (AE): One more ask — for partner-integrated POCs (vendor-hosted), we need a "vendor surcharge" checkbox on quotes. Can RevOps add that to quote templates?
Clara (RevOps): Yep will add a checkbox and a short tooltip: "Vendor/integration surcharge may apply — see ratecard section 4.2".
Ben (Deal Desk): I'll create a deal desk playbook for fastpass approvals: criteria + required artifacts (signed NDA, expected token volume, POC end date). Will publish later today.
Asha (Sales): Great. Action items: Ben -> playbook & triage queue; Clara -> billing note + quote template; Jo -> amendment template; Darin -> list of active POC SKUs that need manual mapping. I'll draft the external comms after we close these.
Ben (Deal Desk): noted. Ping me when you drop the list, Darin.
Darin (AE): Will send the list in this thread by EOD.
Asha (Sales): Thanks team. If anyone spots an edge-case (education discounts, nonprofit), flag it here and we can treat as separate exception flow. :thumbsup:
